title: dryopteris cambrensis subsp. insubrica
intro: Dryopteris cambrensis subsp. insubrica, commonly known as  Alpine wood fern, is a subspecies of fern native to the European Alps. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and it is believed to have several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris cambrensis subsp. insubrica include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and act as an antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant are flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and potential interactions.
